entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought a few weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To best help, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
It's the fit. I've tried them on a couple of rides, adjusted the cleats multiple times, and they just keep giving me terrible blisters on my heels. They're just not working for my feet.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Discomfort and blisters are definitely not what we want for our customers. Can I get your order number to pull up the details?

Sure, it's VF-8675309. I know it's been about three and a half weeks. If a full refund isn't possible, I'd be willing to discuss a partial credit or a discount code for a different pair of cycling shoes. I just can't use these ones.
I appreciate that. Let me just check the policy here... one moment. Okay, I see the delivery was 26 days ago. That's no problem at all. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. So a full refund is possible then?

Yes, absolutely. You're well within the window. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive them, we'll process your full refund back to the original payment method.
That's fantastic, and much easier than I expected. Thank you so much for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
